downloadAttachmentFromFormField.name: downloadAttachmentFromFormField
downloadAttachmentFromFormField.description: Downloads a specific attachment from a form field of your process.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single attachment file stored on a form field of a Kissflow process item and returns it as a file. Use this to retrieve a known attachment by its identifiers; it requires the full address of the file (process ID, instance ID, activity instance ID, field ID, and attachment ID). Read-only and idempotent: repeating the call with the same IDs returns the same file without side effects.
